title: Pullback cochain maps of augmented computing pairings
statement: Let $f:X'\to X$ be a scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme], $F,G$ module sheaves on $X$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], $f^*$ tensor pullback [def-pc-module-pullback], and $\eta$ its adjunction unit [def-weil-pbc-module-cohomology-fmap]. Let $\tau:f^*(F\otimes G)\to f^*F\otimes f^*G$ be the section-normalized tensor comparison [lem-weil-pbc-module-pullback-tensor], for the sheaf tensor [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. There exist computing pairings $D$ of $F,G$ and $E$ of $f^*F,f^*G$ [def-sc-module-cup-resolution-data] and sheaf cochain maps $l:D_l.K\to f_*E_l.K$, $r:D_r.K\to f_*E_r.K$, $t:D_t.K\to f_*E_t.K$ over $\eta_F$, $\eta_G$ and $f_*(\tau)\eta_{F\otimes G}$, respectively: their degree-zero augmentation squares commute. Their canonical additive global maps $\Gamma_f(l),\Gamma_f(r),\Gamma_f(t)$ [lem-sc-module-cup-resolution-fmap] preserve the section pairing in every bidegree: $\Gamma_f(t)^{p+q}(D.\mathrm{pair}^{p,q}(a,b))=E.\mathrm{pair}^{p,q}(\Gamma_f(l)^p(a),\Gamma_f(r)^q(b))$ for all global sections $a,b$. No equation on cohomology classes is part of the assertion.

proof.text: Apply moduleCup_pullback_flasque_complexes to obtain the six integer flasque resolutions, tensor chain maps u and u1, and the three sheaf cochain f-maps with their degree-zero squares and the sectionwise pairing equation on every open. Extract these witnesses in stages to avoid repeatedly elaborating the large existential telescope.

On each scheme restrict the three integer complexes along embeddingUpNat. Reuse the proved private restriction, natAugmentation, computingFlasqueResolution and tensorChainSectionPair API of ModuleCupPairingExists through a proof-only import all. The local computingPairing helper packages these resolutions: the tensor summand formula commutes with sheaf restrictions; the tensor chain differential gives signed Leibniz, with natural/integer sign and index transports; and the degree-zero tensor formulas give augmentation_pair. Flasque acyclicity and the right-acyclic resolution comparison furnish the global homology isomorphisms required by computes. All injective comparisons are constructed by descOfQuasiIso over the identity, without choosing arbitrary existential data.

Restrict l,r,t along embeddingUpNat; restriction commutes definitionally with termwise pushforward. At degree zero natAugmentation has the original augmentation component, so the three f-map squares follow from the supplied integer squares. The target square uses precisely the existing section-normalized tensor-pullback comparison.

Unfold the canonical global f-map component: it first applies the sheaf f-map on the top open and then restricts from f-inverse(top) to top. Apply the supplied sectionwise pairing equation at top, followed by restriction naturality of the tensor summand followed by u1. The opposite homOfLE for top <= f-inverse(top) equals the eqToHom used by cupPushforwardSectionsIso by subsingleton elimination in the opens category. This gives exactly the required strict global pairing identity.

lean.statement:
theorem moduleCup_pullback_augmented_pairings (X X' : Scheme.{v}) (f : X' ⟶ X)
    (F G : X.Modules) :
    ∃ (D : CupResolutionPairing F G)
      (E : CupResolutionPairing ((tensorPullback f).obj F) ((tensorPullback f).obj G))
      (l : D.left.K ⟶
        ((pushforward f).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj E.left.K)
      (r : D.right.K ⟶
        ((pushforward f).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj E.right.K)
      (t : D.target.K ⟶
        ((pushforward f).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj E.target.K),
      (D.left.augmentation.f 0 ≫ l.f 0 =
        (Classical.choose (exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction f)).unit.app F ≫
          (pushforward f).map (E.left.augmentation.f 0)) ∧
      (D.right.augmentation.f 0 ≫ r.f 0 =
        (Classical.choose (exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction f)).unit.app G ≫
          (pushforward f).map (E.right.augmentation.f 0)) ∧
      (D.target.augmentation.f 0 ≫ t.f 0 =
        (Classical.choose (exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction f)).unit.app (F ⊗ G) ≫
          (pushforward f).map ((Classical.choose (module_pullback_tensor f) F G).hom) ≫
          (pushforward f).map (E.target.augmentation.f 0)) ∧
      (∀ (p q : ℕ) (a : Γ(D.left.K.X p, ⊤)) (b : Γ(D.right.K.X q, ⊤)),
        (cupResolutionGlobalMap f t).f (p + q) (D.pair p q ⊤ a b) =
          E.pair p q ⊤ ((cupResolutionGlobalMap f l).f p a)
            ((cupResolutionGlobalMap f r).f q b))
